article.headline: Ryan Mela scores 23 to lift Providence to 72-66 OT victory over VCU at Maui Invitational
article.description: — Ryan Mela scored 23 points and Providence took down VCU 72-66 in overtime on Monday at the Maui Invitational.
article.linkText: Ryan Mela scores 23 to lift Providence to 72-66 OT victory over VCU at Maui Invitational

article.story: LAHAINA, Hawaii -- — Ryan Mela scored 23 points and Providence took down VCU 72-66 in overtime on Monday at the Maui Invitational. Mela added six rebounds and three steals for the Friars (5-1). Malik Mack scored 19 points, going 8 of 15 (2 for 5 from 3-point range). Arrinten Page had 13 points and shot 5 of 11 from the field and 2 for 4 from the line. Blake Harper finished with 15 points and four steals for the Rams (3-2). Lazar Djokovic added 13 points and Torey Alston scored 10. VCU trailed 40-35 at halftime, but it took a 3-pointer and a free throw in the final 1:11 from Page to send it to OT tied at 64. Mack and Page had the first two baskets and the Friars never trailed in the extra 5-minute period. Up next for Providence is a matchup Tuesday with Stonehill at home. VCU hosts Coppin State on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
